pattern: {p:Player} look[s] at the top {n:Qty} cards of their library and may reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card from among them . each player puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order
subject: none

examples.text: Each player looks at the top four cards of their library and may reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card from among them. Each player puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.

Each player looks at the top six cards of their library and may reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card from among them. Each player puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.

counterExamples: Each player looks at the top four cards of their library and may reveal a land card or an instant or sorcery card from among them. Each player puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.

Each player looks at the top four cards of their library and may reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card from among them. Each player puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on top of their library in any order.

Each opponent looks at the top four cards of their library and may reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card from among them. Each opponent puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.
